definition.columns: Fixed checkpoint labels in the specified order
definition.coordinate_contract: Saved model/world coordinates; X/Y front and Z/Y side. No recentering, scaling, rotation, smoothing or geometry mutation.
definition.cut_contract: C-only axis-aligned bbox midpoint: FRONT Z=(C_z_min+C_z_max)/2; SIDE X=(C_x_min+C_x_max)/2. Existing helper index=1 of fractions .25/.50/.75; only .50 is rendered.
definition.intersection_contract: Existing FP64 finite triangle-plane intersection; eps=1e-12*L. Coplanar triangles contribute finite edges. No projected silhouette or infinite face extrapolation.
definition.limitations: Two predetermined central cuts can miss off-plane contacts and surfaces. Coplanar edges may overprint. Neither line count nor visible contact certifies layers, adoption or indexed topology. Blue is drawn above gray; exact overlap needs existing independent diagnostics.
definition.normal_contract: Original source C winding, not outward/interior certification; source metadata validation only, no orientation solver.
definition.scale_contract: Identical C-derived bounds for every checkpoint, RAW/POST and all four noises within a condition; equal coordinate aspect. Partial-endpoint selection cannot change the C-only local bounds.
